blind_extractions.arms: Collagen arm: GOLD COLLAGEN FORTE (50 mL daily, 5,000 mg hydrolysed fish collagen type I plus hyaluronic acid, N-acetylglucosamine, borage oil, vitamins, minerals and antioxidants incl. resveratrol, CoQ10, lycopene), n randomised 60. Control arm: placebo 50 mL bottle (water, stevia, flavouring, acids), n randomised 60. All 60 per arm analysed at day 90 (paper gives n = 60 for each measurement; no dropouts reported). Subgroups: with cosmetic treatment (test n=33, placebo n=36), without (test n=27, placebo n=24). Only 2 visits: day 0 and day 90.
blind_extractions.direction_notes: Elasticity measured as Young's elasticity modulus (SkinLab USB Elasticity Module, DermaLab). Paper treats an increase as improvement: 'A significant increase in skin elasticity was seen in subjects consuming the test product' and the placebo fall is described as 'a significant decrease (-5%) in skin elasticity'. (Physically a higher Young's modulus means stiffer skin, which is the opposite of better; the paper does not discuss this. Flagged.) No instrumental hydration or roughness measure was taken. Hydration and fine lines were self-assessment questionnaires only (percent agreeing, bar charts, not numerically extractable); photographs of crow's feet / nasolabial folds were qualitative only.
blind_extractions.problems: 1) Unit printed as 'mm' for Young's elasticity modulus, which is not a modulus unit (internal oddity). 2) Overall test-vs-placebo comparison at day 90 was NOT significant (stated: 'the difference was not significant in both cases' at day 0 and day 90); the headline +7.5% is a within-group change. 3) Test product baseline (7.51) is lower than placebo baseline (7.90); no baseline-adjusted between-group analysis. 4) Significant between-group difference only in the without-cosmetic-treatment subgroup at day 90 (7.17 vs 8.17, p<=0.05); this is the subgroup (n=24 vs 27) and is a post hoc subgroup analysis. 5) Subgroup means are internally consistent with the overall means (weighted averages reproduce 7.90/7.52/7.51/8.07). 6) Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 values are printed in the text, so no chart reading was needed; abstract and text say mean +/- SEM ('presented here as mean +/- SEM' in Statistical Analysis). 7) Subjects described as 40-60 years; 57.5% had a cosmetic facial treatment (botox/filler) during the trial. 8) Abstract says ' +7.5%, p<=0.001'; paired t test used within group, unpaired t test between groups, no ANCOVA. 9) Percent changes printed are computed from group means (e.g. +0.56/7.51).

Control arm: placebo 20 mL beverage without CPs; randomised 38, analysed 34 (4 withdrew). Per-protocol analysis; 80 assessed, 3 refused. Visits: baseline, week 6, week 12. blind_extractions.problems: 1) Group n inconsistent: text says younger test n=45 / placebo n=41 and older test n=16 / placebo n=18; Fig. 2 legend says younger test n=44, older test n=17 (placebo 41 and 18). 2) Younger-subgroup values differ between text and chart: text test day 0 7.8 +/- 0.2 and day 90 9.6 +/- 0.2; chart reads ~7.95 and ~9.75. 3) Baseline differed significantly between arms in overall (7.9 vs 6.9, P<.05) and younger (7.8 vs 6.6, P<.05) groups; the '+40%' (9.8 vs 7.0), '+43%' (9.6 vs 6.7) and '+34%' (9.8 vs 7.3) headline figures are BETWEEN-GROUP day-90 comparisons, not within-group changes. Within-group changes: +24% overall, +23% younger, +22% older (day 90 vs baseline). 4) Abstract says '+40%; P<0.0001' while text says P<.001. 5) Dispersion: Methods say 'means +/- SEM or SD'; Fig. 2 legend says SEM; text values taken as SEM (not explicitly labelled in text). Table 2 demographics are SD. 6) Fig 2 legend says 'two-way ANOVA with Tukey'; text says repeated-measures ANOVA for within-group and unspecified test between groups. 7) Placebo older subgroup SEM is large (0.8) with n=18, implausibly large vs other groups. 8) Day 30 and day 60 values only available from chart (estimates). 9) Chart baseline for 51-70 test arm ~8.0 and placebo ~7.65 matches text (8.0, 7.7). 10) Unit of Young's modulus not stated (axis 'Young's modulus'). 11) In older group text says elasticity increased 'only at day 90 ... when compared to the placebo group' but then says within-group significant at day 60 (+10%) and day 90 (+22%). 12) Funding and authors from sponsor MINERVA.

blind_extractions.arms: Collagen hydrolysate (CH): 5 g/day Nippi FCP-EX fish scale and skin collagen hydrolysate powder, dissolved in water, once daily in the morning before breakfast for 4 weeks (Procedures, PDF p3). Placebo: 5 g maltodextrin. Double-blind RCT in healthy Thai post-menopausal women 50-60 y. Enrolled 38; 2 CH participants could not be contacted after randomisation, so CH n=17, placebo n=19 (Results, PDF p3); no dropouts afterwards; analysed n=17 and 19 at all visits (Table 1 headers). Visits at weeks 0, 2, 4 (end of dosing) and 8 (4 weeks after stopping). Four sites: left and right cheek (sun-exposed), left and right upper inner arm (sun-protected). Measurements in triplicate.

blind_extractions.problems: 1) Primary outcome was change from baseline at 4 weeks; no change-from-baseline means or SDs are printed. The text gives only p values for the change-from-baseline between-group comparison on cheeks (p=.006 left, p=.03 right at 4 weeks; and p=.01 left, p=.004 right at week 8) and says within-collagen change from baseline was p<.001 at all sites. Table 2 gives between-group mean differences of endpoint values (95% CI): left cheek week 2/4/8 = 0.06 (-0.0078, 0.13), 0.09 (0.03, 0.16), 0.09 (0.022, 0.15); right cheek 0.06 (-0.0062, 0.13), 0.10 (0.04, 0.16), 0.09 (0.03, 0.15); left arm 0.02/0.04/0.03; right arm 0.02/0.03/0.03 (all CIs include 0 at arms). 2) p-value inconsistencies: Right-arm baseline p is .42 in Table 2 but .43 in Table 1 and in the text. Left cheek week 0 mean difference -0.0036 (Table 2) versus -0.004 (Table 1). Left cheek p-values in the abstract (cheek p=.006/.03 at week 4) differ from Table 2 week 4 'p<.01' (which is the endpoint comparison, not the change comparison). 3) Text says p=.01 for left cheek week 8 and .004 for right cheek, whereas Table 2 gives .01 (left) and <.01 (right). 4) The text defines the parameter as R7, but the figure axes are labelled 'Net elasticity' (net elasticity is conventionally R5; R7 is the ratio of immediate recovery to total extension), and the cheek means (~0.5) and arm means (~0.82) are plotted as 'Net elasticity'; the label ambiguity is unresolved. 5) Placebo is maltodextrin. 6) Sample size calculated at 40 but only 36 analysed. 7) The paper does not report hydration or roughness outcomes. 8) Figures 1 and 2 show the same means as Table 2 with error bars (legend does not state SD; text says mean ± SD); bar heights visually agree with the table (e.g. right face wk 8: placebo ~0.47, collagen ~0.56). 9) The abstract states significance in 'sun-exposed areas' (cheeks) only; arms were not significantly different at 4 and 8 weeks.

blind_extractions.arms: Test: 2.5 g powder daily containing 2000 mg low-molecular-weight collagen peptides (GPVGPS Collagen, Nile tilapia fish scale) with maltodextrin 348.75 mg, flavor 125 mg, silicon dioxide 25 mg, sucralose 1.25 mg (collagen arm). Placebo: 2.5 g powder, maltodextrin 2348.75 mg plus same flavor, silicon dioxide, sucralose, no nutrients. Randomised 100 (test 51, placebo 49). Test: 4 consent withdrawal + 2 protocol violation removed; placebo: 7 removed. Per-protocol analysed n=45 test, 42 placebo (safety n=100). Visits 0, 4, 8, 12 weeks.
blind_extractions.direction_notes: Roughness Ra, Rmax, Rp, Rv, Rz (um, PRIMOS): decrease described as improvement. Eye wrinkle volume (mm3): the test product decreased and is reported as improvement (Fig 1E, Table 3 shows decrease), so lower = better in this paper (opposite of Kim 2022 wrinkle-volume convention). Hydration (Corneometer, AU): increase described as 'enhanced', higher = better. Elasticity R2 overall, R5 net, R7 biological: higher described as improvements ('greater improvements in test group'). Table 4 header 'Parameter (um)' is a typo.
blind_extractions.problems: Table 4 header reads 'Parameter (um)' though R2/R5/R7 are unitless ratios. Table 4 footnote says R5 is 'ratio of elastic recovery to immediate deformation', R7 'elastic recovery to total deformation'. Placebo R5 declines significantly from baseline (0.53 to 0.51, p=0.0002 at 8W, 0.0009 at 8W per table order) so the between-group R5 benefit partly reflects placebo worsening. Hydration absolute means for placebo and for non-endpoint visits are not tabulated (only test group baseline and 12W values in text; changes in Figure 2 as line charts with no error bars though legend says mean +/- SD). Figure legends say 'Normalized changes ... mean +/- standard deviation' but SD bars are not drawn. Text says eye wrinkle volume placebo 17.67 +/- 6.94 whereas test 8W is shown 17.66 (7.09) and placebo 4W 17.49. Rz text/placebo 12W: 135.44 (31.78), p=0.0259 worsening. Text says R2 change from baseline significant from Week 4 (p<0.0001) but Table 4 test 4W p<0.0001 whereas placebo R2 4W p=0.0136. Text states R7 significant from week 8 (p=0.018), matches Table 4 0.0180. The Wiley download stamp indicates a University of Auckland copy. Elasticity measured above the cheeks; wrinkles periorbital.
